meta.title: Ekklesias
meta.description: Register your church members with a tap, respecting their privacy.

home.tagline: Register your church members with a tap, respecting their privacy.

tap.title: One tap or a QR code
tap.body: Hold the phone to the card and the form opens. Nothing to install.

consent.title: Clear consents
consent.body: Each permission is its own checkbox, recorded with date, version and source.

tenants.title: One platform, many churches
tenants.body: Each church has its own data, branding and team, fully separated.

church.intro: Registering helps us stay in touch. You decide what you share and how we contact you.

fields.phoneHint: Include the country code if it is not Spain, for example +49…
fields.birthHint: We only use it to know whether we need a guardian’s permission.
fields.invitedByHint: Write their name, it helps us say hello.

guardian.notice: As you are under 14, we need the consent of your parent or guardian.
guardian.confirm: I am their parent or legal guardian and I give consent on their behalf.

permissions.intro: Tick only what you want. No box is ticked in advance and you can change your mind at any time.

errors.phone: Enter a valid mobile number, with the country code if it is not Spain.
errors.birthDate: Enter a valid date of birth.
errors.consent: We need you to accept this in order to register you.
errors.guardian: Fill in your parent or guardian’s details and tick their consent.
errors.server: We could not complete the registration. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.rateLimit: Too many forms were sent from this connection. Please wait a while and try again.

thanks.title: Thank you for registering!
thanks.inviteBody: Share it with anyone you want to invite. When someone registers with it, we will know you invited them.
thanks.guardianSent: We have sent an email to your parent or guardian so they can confirm your registration. Until then your permissions will not be active.
thanks.guardianFailed: We could not send the email to your guardian. Tell the church so they can resend it. Until then your permissions will not be active.
thanks.qrAlt: QR code of your personal link: someone else can scan it to join

legal.draft: Draft in progress. This text is not the final version yet and is pending legal review.

preferences.title: Hello, {name}
preferences.intro: Here you can change your permissions at {church} whenever you like. Only the changes you make are saved.
preferences.error: We could not save your changes. Please try again.
preferences.invalidBody: This link has expired or is not correct. Ask your church for a new one.
preferences.withdrawNote: To withdraw your permission to keep your data as a member, or to ask us to delete your data, use
preferences.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Please wait a while and try again.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from messages
unsubscribe.body: We will stop sending you messages by email, WhatsApp and SMS. You will remain registered as a member.
unsubscribe.doneBody: You will not receive any more messages. You can turn them back on whenever you like from your preferences link.
unsubscribe.invalidBody: This link has expired or is not correct. Ask your church for a new one.
unsubscribe.tooManyBody: Wait a few minutes and open the link again.

rights.title: Your rights over your data
rights.intro: You can ask {church} for access, rectification, erasure, portability or objection regarding your data. We will answer within one month.
rights.emailHint: We only use it to answer your request.
rights.type: What do you want to ask for?

types.access: Access: know what data you hold about me
types.portability: Portability: receive my data in a file

errors.type: Choose what you want to ask for.
errors.server: We could not send your request. Please try again.
errors.rate: Too many requests were sent. Please wait a while and try again.

rights.sentBody: If that email matches a registration, the church will reply within one month.

guardian.subject: {church}: confirm the registration of {minor}
guardian.body: {minor} has been registered at {church} and you were named as their parent or legal guardian. Because {minor} is under 14, we need you to confirm that you agree. Until then their data is only stored and not used for anything else.
guardian.action: Confirm or reject the registration at this link:
guardian.expires: The link expires in {days} days and can only be used once.
guardian.ignore: If you do not recognise this registration, you can reject it at the link or ignore this email.

guardianPage.title: Guardian confirmation
guardianPage.ask: {church} received a registration for {minor}, who is under 14. {guardian} was named as their {relationship}. Do you authorise this registration?
guardianPage.data: We store their contact details and permissions, and you can change them or ask for them to be deleted at any time.
guardianPage.confirm: Yes, I am their guardian and I authorise it
guardianPage.confirmedBody: Thank you. The permissions of {minor} are now active.
guardianPage.rejectedBody: Thank you for letting us know. The church will review the registration and will not use this data.
guardianPage.invalidBody: This link has expired or was already used. Ask the church to send you a new one.
guardianPage.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a while and open the link again.

hero.title: Sign people up with a tap. Connect with each one.
hero.body: NFC cards and QR codes to join in a minute, messaging to write to those who allowed it, and an admin panel to keep every record under control.

steps.title: From a tap to a conversation

items.title: One tap and they're in
items.body: Everyone gets an NFC card or a QR code. The form opens with nothing to install and no account to create.

items.title: They introduce themselves their way
items.body: Name, mobile and little else. Each permission (email, WhatsApp, photos, visibility) is its own checkbox and never ticked in advance.

items.title: Your team takes the next step
items.body: Leaders see those who agreed to be visible and know which channel they prefer. All that's left is to say hello.

community.title: Everyone who arrives has someone behind them.
community.body: Almost nobody comes to church alone: someone spoke to them, invited them, sat with them the first time. Ekklesias keeps that bond so the community can see itself grow and nobody gets lost along the way.

items.title: Every invitation counts
items.body: Every member has a personal link. You see who invited whom and who to thank.

items.title: A welcome on time
items.body: You know who arrived this week, so you can greet them while they still remember their first visit.

items.title: No one is left out
items.body: Those who came on their own have a place too: they are recorded as people who found the church by themselves.

members.title: They get to know you, and you decide

items.title: You decide
items.body: Change your permissions or leave with a personal link, whenever you want, without calling anyone.

items.title: Your rights, one click away
items.body: Ask to access your data, correct it or have it deleted. The church receives the request and has to answer it.

items.title: No small print
items.body: We record which text you accepted and when, so you can always check what you said yes to.

trust.title: Closeness, with respect.
trust.body: Belonging to a church is sensitive information, so we take care of it. Each church is responsible for its data and Ekklesias safeguards it on its behalf, designed from the start for GDPR and Spain's LOPDGDD, with data on servers in the European Union.

facts.label: independent permissions, none ticked in advance
languages: Spanish, English, German and Arabic

cta.title: Start a conversation
cta.body: Sign up the way someone visiting your church for the first time would, and feel what it's like.

landing.footer: Demo version. The legal texts are drafts pending review.

features.title: Everything your team needs, in one place

items.title: NFC and QR codes
items.body: A card, a tag or a poster: tapping a phone or scanning opens the form, with no app and no account. Every member has a personal link, and you know which channel each person came through.

items.title: Messaging
items.body: Write by email, WhatsApp or SMS only to those who gave permission for that channel, and segment by permissions or by who invited whom.

items.title: Admin panel
items.body: Member list and search, a full-history record for each person, rights requests, CSV export and a team with administrator and leader roles.

items.title: Control over records
items.body: Guardians confirm minors, you can delete data when someone asks, publish new versions of your legal texts and see who viewed each record.
